The letter {{AurB|y}} was the twenty-fifth letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet. It was pronounced "yirt", and had the value of /Y/.<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

Uses:
*[[Yirt-4138-Grek-12]] and the [[Raid on Yirt-4138-Grek-12]]
